newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: European gold pauses, seen testing support.
newsitem.headline: European gold pauses, seen testing support.

text.p: Gold opened lower in quiet, early Tuesday European trading as the market paused after its recent rally.
Dealers said prices had come down on a lack of fresh buying interest and were expected to test support levels at $346.50.
If gold failed to meet support at that level, it might ease to next support at $345.00 an ounce, dealers added.
Gold opened at $347.00/347.50, down from its previous London close of $349.90/350.40, but only slightly lower than New York's close of $347.40/347.90.
Silver was also easier at 483/485 cents from 490/494 with next major support at 475.
White metals followed the trend with platinum quoted at $389.00/390.00 from $396.25/397.25 and palladium at $169.00/170.00 vs $173.50/174.50.
